correctness.rationale: The fixed-point equation is exactly \(x=A^{\mathsf T}x^{[2]}\); Lang gives a conjugating matrix and \(2^n\) geometric points. Frobenius descent gives a binary invertible matrix whose fixed space indexes rational idempotents. Twisted matrix-orbit stabilizers equal binary centralizers, so the class weights agree with the uniform binary general linear group. Subspace-lattice Möbius inversion gives the displayed formula. Independently implemented complete enumeration verified 24053 actual invertible matrices across 8 finite-field/dimension configurations. The general theorem is a proof, not extrapolation from finite tests.

value.rationale: An intrinsic count of rational idempotent elements is a natural invariant; the complete distribution under all invertible n-dimensional evolution structures over every characteristic-two finite field is stronger than an existing mean-only theorem and an existence-only dimension-two statement. The exact q-independence and binary fixed-space interpretation identify nontrivial field arithmetic and make every event calculable without algebra-class enumeration. No downstream applications beyond this family are asserted.
